q.exp_en: According to the data, Lee So-ra is in a legal dispute over neighboring rights, and her agency applied for an attachment order on 45 songs.

q.exp_en: According to the text, the system where the breach occurred is the 'Regular Evaluation Support System'.

q.exp_en: According to the data, foreign women in hijabs filmed inside a spa in Busan, resulting in the police being called.

q.exp_ko: 자료에 따르면 김형년 두나무 부회장은 국내 디지털자산 기업들이 새로운 금융서비스를 개발할 기술은 갖췄지만, 각종 규제에 막혀 실제 사업으로 이어가지 못하고 있다고 지적했습니다.

choices_ko: 인공지능(AI) 투자 확대에 따른 메모리 호황
choices_en: Memory boom due to expanded AI investment
Supply increase and supply-demand changes after 2028
Upward adjustment of next year's earnings forecast

q.exp_en: According to the facts, the Financial Security Institute was hacked and some security-related information leaked.

q.ko: 이번 해킹으로 금융보안원의 핵심 보안 망이 직접적인 공격을 받아 완전히 파괴되었습니다.
